title: OrganizationSettingsUpdateRequest v1
description: PATCH /organizations/settings request body — Wave B2B-10. `expectedVersion` travels in the If-Match header, not the body. Item 11 adversarial review (2026-09-25) real finding: this route had no Ajv schema at all, so a non-string field (e.g. a number) reached UpdateOrganizationSettingsService.update() and crashed as an uncaught TypeError (500) instead of a clean 400.
